searchText: https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/pull/178 has the PR for the `prepare_beacon_proposers` endpoint required for the merge. Please have a read through and let me know if you have any concerns/comments/questions. Note that this will, of course, be subject to change once it is being used in testnets and we have some real-world experience.
